ewa-beach-first-tongan-gmc-hi.assessment: Ewa Beach First Tongan Global Methodist Church is one of three Tongan-language GMC congregations in Hawaii, all on the Western States Conference find-a-church map. Meets at host facility Messiah Lutheran Church on Fort Weaver Road. Rev. Alani Tu'itupou leads the 1 PM Sunday service. Wesleyan-orthodox by GMC identity; Tongan-language services are a strong cultural fit for the local Polynesian community.

score_notes.denominational: Global Methodist Church per Western States Conference find-a-church listing.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Not explicitly documented; small Tongan-language congregation.
